rootCauses: Host apps were killed by OpenHarmony under memory pressure (about 90 MB free); the apps' Android windows belonged to the killed host, so a restarted host showed an empty window. Freeing memory removed the blank screens; Westlake does not re-attach windows to a restarted host.
renewalFinding: Spotify and Wattpad request no Google token while signed in; signing out signs them out of Google, so signing in again is interactive. Silent renewal is not observable through either app.
openConfiguration: Resolved 2026-11-18: Play services' return routes now list every client app (launch configuration); Wattpad's Google login returned to Wattpad by itself.
facebookBlocker: Facebook answered a new web login (dedicated Wattpad) with reCAPTCHA; the agent does not solve CAPTCHAs, so the Facebook checks wait for a person. The board's Facebook app was never signed in.
hostWatchExemption: Observed: Play services' main and persistent processes log that the launch serves other apps and keeps running if its host ends.

facebook20261119.summary: The user completed Facebook's reCAPTCHA on the D600 twice (Wattpad, then Spotify); the agent typed the test login through a masked helper and did not solve either CAPTCHA.
facebook20261119.touchInput: A finger on the D600 did nothing at first: these launches use the launcher's isolated touch mode, which makes a private tap mailbox and starts no touch forwarder, and OpenHarmony delivers screen touches to windows Westlake does not register. The forwarder was started by hand for the app on screen.
facebook20261119.wattpad: New Facebook-linked Wattpad account created with the test defaults; profile shows the Facebook name, picture and link; after a full restart Wattpad reopened signed in to it.
facebook20261119.spotify: Facebook signed in and its redirect returned to Spotify in-process; Spotify refused a Facebook sign-up ("Signing up with Facebook isn't available right now"). Session and restart checks need a Facebook-linked Spotify account or a scope change. Spotify was signed back in with Google.
facebook20261119.pcLink: At 15:14 PST the PC's shared hdc server lost the D600's USB session (the OnePlus had dropped into Qualcomm crash-dump mode moments earlier); it recovered on its own by 15:22 without a restart, and the D600 did not reboot.

uberMap20261119.cause: Board test: OH's EGL imports RGBA_8888 and BGRA_8888 native buffers as images but not RGBX_8888 (0x3000) or RGB_888 (0x3003). Uber's map set its TextureView window to RGBX_8888.
uberMap20261119.fix: westlake ffdc31c: the bionic shim records native-image producer windows and gives them RGBA_8888 for RGBX_8888 or RGB_888. Deployed to Uber's runtime only (shim 00e85de5, previous kept as .cur-texfmt1).
uberMap20261119.result: Destination search and fare preview observed; nothing booked. Map tiles not seen.
uberMap20261119.minor: Back from Uber's home closes its main screen and leaves the host's black window; bringing the host forward does not reopen it.
